job.title: Experienced Labourer
job.description:
About MobReady: 
MobReady is a socially inclusive Group Training Organisation (GTO) offering traineeship and apprenticeship opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. A recognised Supply Nation Certified business, our vision is to stimulate positive change by providing trainee and apprentice employment opportunities, supporting a diverse and inclusive workplace culture toward achieving sustainable outcomes.
 
The Role: 
We are currently searching for First Nations candidates with experience in the Civil Construction industry as a laborer or tunnel labourer.
 
This is your opportunity to join a growing civil company on an exciting project in Badgery's Creek. 
 
You'll work with a skilled team working on civil laboring and micro tunnelling. 
 
Pay Rate: $30.70 per hour (Negotiated with experience)

Criteria:
  • Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander
  • Pre-Employment Medical including drug & alcohol
  • White Card
  • Car & Licence (due to location)
  • Working at heights & confined spaces
Shift times vary but are generally 10 hours per day and commence at 7am.
 
This role is targeted for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates only. 
  
This is a targeted position under the anti-Discrimination Act 1977 persons of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent are encouraged to apply and preference for the role. If this sounds like you, APPLY NOW! Please reach out to us for a yarn.

MobReady is a socially inclusive Group Training Organisation (GTO) offering traineeship and apprenticeship opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. A recognised Supply Nation Certified business, our vision is to stimulate positive change by providing trainee and apprentice employment opportunities, supporting a diverse and inclusive workplace culture toward achieving sustainable outcomes.
 
The Role: 
We are actively seeking motivated First Nations candidates to kickstart your career as an Electrical Apprentice, working across various projects in Sydney, starting on a major project in Ryde. Over the 4 years, you will work with a highly skilled team to learn all the tricks of the trade. 
 
You will gain electrical experience, whilst working on construction projects across Sydney and also completing a Cert III Electrotechnology.
 
Immediate start available.
 
Work sites are across Greater Sydney with first project based in Ryde.
 
This role is targeted for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates only. 
 
FEMALE CANDIDATES STRONGLY ENCOURAGED TO APPLY!
 
The successful candidate will receive Culturally sensitive mentoring to ensure they have all the support necessary to succeed. 
 
Key Responsibilities:
Under the guidance and supervision of the qualified team, you will be required to carry out repairing, maintaining and installation works of electrical equipment in line with your training/apprenticeship level, as well as any other reasonable duties expected of an Electrical Apprentice.

  • Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander Female
  • Car & Licence
  • Pass a Police check (flexible)

  • White Card

job.title: Banking Services Traineeship
job.description:
About MobReady: 
MobReady is an Aboriginal owned & operated Group Training Organisation (GTO) offering traineeship and apprenticeship opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. A recognised Supply Nation Certified business, our vision is to stimulate positive change by providing trainee and apprentice employment opportunities, supporting a diverse and inclusive workplace culture toward achieving sustainable outcomes.
 
The Role: 
The Banking Services Trainee supports the delivery of banking services to Australian Government customers
while undertaking a structured traineeship program.

The role provides practical experience in banking operations, customer service and administration. The trainee
develops knowledge, skills and capabilities through a combination of workplace learning, formal training and on-the-job coaching.

Key Accountabilities
Banking Operations
- Assist with the processing of banking transactions and operational activities.
- Learn and apply banking procedures, policies and systems.
- Support the maintenance of accurate records and documentation.
- Assist with reconciliations and routine reporting activities.

Customer Service
- Respond to customer enquiries in a professional and timely manner.
- Escalate customer issues to appropriate team members when required.
- Develop an understanding of customer service standards and expectations.

Administration and Team Support
- Provide administrative support to the branch as required.
- Contribute to the efficient operation of the team.
- Participate in team meetings and workplace activities.

Learning and Development
- Complete all requirements of the traineeship qualification.
- Actively participate in coaching, training and development activities.
- Apply learning from formal training in the workplace.
- Demonstrate a commitment to continuous improvement and personal development.

This role is targeted for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates only. 
 
The successful candidate will receive Culturally sensitive mentoring to ensure they have all the support necessary to succeed. 
 
Ideal Candidate Traits:
  • Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander
  • Pass a police check
  • Ability to read & write, willingness to learn
  • Interest in financial services
  • Basic computer skills
  • Punctuality and reliability
